metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the LAS 1.4 inspector and renderer in [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs), with the dependency-free Cargo manifest at [Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml).

It handles point formats 0–10, public headers, VLRs and EVLRs, CRS records, waveform fields and records, and Extra Bytes metadata. Malformed standard records and inconsistent file metadata are reported as errors; waveform packet payloads are preserved opaquely.

`cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml` succeeds. The program accepts `--input <path>` and `--output <path>`.
